title: trigonella corniculata subsp. balansae
intro: Trigonella corniculata subsp. balansae, commonly known as Balansa's fenugreek, is a sub-species of the fenugreek plant, belonging to the legume family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help manage blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Balansa's fenugreek include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
